title: Head of Brand & UX
sourceText: About The CompanyA fast-growing digital health platform focused on diabetes and weight management, helping hundreds of thousands of members manage chronic conditions through connected devices, coaching, and a consumer app. Backed by leading healthcare-focused investors, the company is scaling its consumer experience across India and international markets.The RoleWe're looking for a senior, hands-on brand and UX leader to shape how the company shows up — visually, verbally, and experientially — across product and marketing. This is an individual contributor role for someone who wants to lead through craft and judgment rather than headcount: setting the brand vision and design direction, then rolling up their sleeves to execute at a high bar.RequirementsWhat You'll DoOwn end-to-end brand identity — voice, visual language, and positioning — across the app, website, and marketing channelsLead UX strategy and design for key consumer journeys, from onboarding to chronic care engagement, balancing clinical trust with everyday usabilityPartner closely with product, marketing, and clinical teams to translate business and health outcomes into intuitive, well-designed experiencesEstablish and evolve design systems, brand guidelines, and UX standards as the company scalesBring an external point of view on category trends in consumer health, wellness, and behavior-change designWhat We're Looking For10+ years of experience spanning brand and UX/product design, ideally with senior individual-contributor experience at a consumer tech, D2C, or digital health companyA strong portfolio demonstrating both brand craft (identity, storytelling, visual systems) and UX rigor (research-informed, outcome-driven design)Comfort operating at both strategic and execution levels — equally at ease presenting a brand vision to leadership and shipping a redesigned flowExperience in healthcare, wellness, or behavior-change products is a strong plus, but not mandatorySomeone who wants ownership and impact without managing a large teamBenefitsWhy JoinHigh-ownership IC role with direct influence on product and brand directionWork on a mission-driven product improving health outcomes for a large, underserved populationBacked by healthcare-focused investors with a strong founder-market fit and growth trajectory Show more Show less
